task: GiveBetter USA discovery wave2: 40 new provisional candidates, initial pool20 to60
status: Discovery hypotheses only; no numerical cost-effectiveness claims, accepted D100 or final25 decisions

model.evidence: Explicit parent assignment: Astra Medium continuing; not inferred from a costing model

geography_rule: Only US-resident benefit is in scope. Domestic activity must be supported; foreign benefits excluded even for US nonprofits. Regional US organizations allowed and accurately described.
gift_scope_rule: Ordinary unrestricted gift to whole recipient, including overhead, portfolio/country mix, revenue substitution, partner roles and real funding capacity. No selected-program-only valuation.
provenance_note: Sequential per-organization helper intervals capture source retrieval. Coverage remains partial: off-interval source review, synthesis, metadata creation and general deduplication are not measured or apportioned. No modeling or independent audit sessions claimed. Batch times are task span, not report research totals. Original open records persisted with apply_patch; closed helper records retained here.
identity_note: Names identify provisional candidate organizations, not completed legal due diligence. Legal names/EINs present are organization-self-reported in retrieved primary text; none independently checked against IRS. Local discovery_id values are row identifiers, not entity IDs.

deduplication.against_initial20: No exact-name overlap; none of PAN or Patient Advocate Foundation included. Their merged organization stays in initial20.
deduplication.within_wave: 40 unique provisional organization names; national affiliates/program brands and c4 arms explicitly excluded as separate entries.
deduplication.remaining_gate: Confirm legal recipients, fiscal sponsorship and recent merger status before accepted discovery count; exact-name exclusion alone is not comprehensive legal deduplication.

workspace.baseline: Geography-plan checkout36MB, filesystem61GiB free; no generated bulk.
